verdict.rationale: Stripe Invoicing documents automation features such as automatic reminders, payment retries, and API-driven collection, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions versioning, reviewing, or rolling back those automation configurations. Voiding invoices, issuing credit notes, and CLI sandboxes are adjacent features, not version control or rollback for automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
